about.heading: Hi, I'm Lennard
about.intro: Virtual assistant with a background in IT
about.bio:
After years of working as an executive assistant at tech companies in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, I decided to go independent in 2023. I combine my administrative expertise with deep knowledge of the IT sector to truly help entrepreneurs.

My clients are typically growing SaaS companies, digital agencies and IT freelancers looking for a reliable partner — someone who quickly understands how their business works and adds value from day one.
